ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) pixels occupy approximately 70% of the surface area, with low-intensity (black) pigmentation occupying approximately 30%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central lobe regions; concentrated black pigmentation along the entire trailing edge and surrounding the median notch; dendritic black patterns extending inward from the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped indentation with an estimated pixel angle of 95 degrees and moderate depth relative to the lobe midline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-frequency serrations and small notches; serration amplitude is highest at the distal lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curvature of the leading edges with a sharp posterior-superior sweep terminating at the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small dark circular clusters visible on the right distal tip and interspersed within the black pigmentation of the trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple vertical, high-contrast linear streaks (rake marks) crossing the white pigmentation on the left lobe; less distinct vertical streaks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant serration and irregular chipping across the trailing margin; distinct vertical rake marks on both lobes.
